name: New Haven Zen Center
reason: Too thin: its own site (www.newhavenzen.org, a four-page Weebly site; robots.txt allows us) shows only the weekly practice schedule and an introduction session on the home page, with no retreats, courses or resources pages of its own and no YouTube channel linked (about 1-2 items).
